title: ui test flake: studioAddress.guard "no ui source outside the builder spells one" times out at 15 s under shard load (ejected #37114 twice)
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Filing gate: ① a test defect found while handling a merge-queue ejection; it blocks the landing of PR #37114 (seen twice with the same signature). Untriaged: grade, domain and state are triage's. Suggested route: zone a4-S (Studio, epic #36890), the owner of the guard added by #36895 / PR #36973.

## Signature

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioAddress.guard.test.ts:153` › `no Studio address is built by hand under ui/ (objectstack#36895)` › `no ui source outside the builder spells one` — `Error: Test timed out in 15000ms`.

- First hit: merge-queue run 45501281672 (PR #37114 ejected).
- Second hit: PR-side run on #37114's merge-only head `150338157`, job `Test UI (1/16)` (138901843717). The other 517 files in that shard pass.
- #37114 changes one comment under `ui/e2e` and a manifest JSON; nothing in the guard's input or import closure.

## Mechanism (read from the file at origin/main; not force-reproduced)

The test walks every `src` tree under `ui/packages/*` and `ui/apps/*` synchronously (`readdirSync` + `statSync` per entry) and runs the TypeScript parser (`handBuiltStudioAddresses`, a full `ts.createSourceFile` + AST visit) over every non-test source file — the whole ui workspace — inside the default 15 s test budget. On a busy 16-way shard runner the walk plus parse exceeds 15 s.

## Fix (test only)

- Pre-filter before parsing: only parse a file whose text contains `/studio` or `STUDIO_ROOT_PATH` (the matcher can hit nothing else). Keep the controls (the builder file still fires; the two named files are still walked).
- Give the case an explicit timeout sized to the walk (e.g. 60 s), as the second line of defence.
- Pin: the existing matcher case stays; add one assertion that the pre-filter never skips a file the matcher would flag (run the matcher over the skipped set in the control, or assert the pre-filter is a superset by construction).

No product change.

Dedupe: `studioAddress` — no open card.
